title: HR Generalist
summary: HR generalists run day-to-day people processes for a site or business unit, from joining and exit formalities to payroll inputs, PF and ESI (provident fund and state insurance) filings and HR policies. They sit in the HR team, answer employee questions and support managers on grievances and discipline.
dailyDuties: Complete joining formalities and induction for new employees
Send monthly attendance, leave and exit inputs to payroll
Prepare and file PF and ESI challans and keep statutory registers
Answer employee questions on leave, policies and pay
Handle grievances and support managers with disciplinary cases
Update employee records in the HRMS and prepare HR MIS reports
Conduct exit interviews and process full and final settlements

skills.expectation: Run joining formalities, induction and exit formalities including full and final inputs
Keep PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH and Shops and Establishments records and filings correct
Send accurate monthly attendance, leave, joiner and exit inputs to payroll
Handle employee queries and grievances and advise managers on disciplinary steps
Maintain HR policies, letters and employee records and explain policies to staff
Keep employee data, leave and attendance up to date in an HRMS
Prepare headcount, attrition and other HR MIS reports in Excel
Explain policies and decisions clearly to employees and managers
Coordinate the appraisal cycle and track forms and ratings
Plan engagement activities and run engagement surveys
Support hiring for junior roles when the team needs it
Use pivot tables and lookups to reconcile HR data
Work with finance, payroll vendors and business heads

certifications.why: Shows the Excel skills used for HR MIS reports
